project.name: E2E Screen UI Demo
project.description: Tests generation of software UI and screen recordings — common in product explainer videos, hard for AI models

source.text: Managing your tasks should not feel like a second job.
With a cleaner design, you see only what matters right now.

source.prompt: New notification badges pop up. Another modal window slides in on top of existing ones. A loading spinner appears in the corner. The feeling of chaos builds.

generate.prompt: A laptop screen displaying an overly complex project management dashboard. Dozens of tiny cards in columns, too many notification badges showing '99+', overlapping modal windows, a cramped sidebar with 30+ menu items. The screen feels chaotic and overwhelming. Realistic product screenshot style, slight perspective angle showing the laptop on a desk.

source.prompt: A cursor smoothly clicks a checkbox on the top task. The task fades out with a satisfying animation. The remaining tasks slide up gently to fill the space.

generate.prompt: The same laptop now displays a beautifully minimal task manager. A clean white interface with just three task cards visible, each with a simple checkbox, title, and subtle color-coded priority dot. Generous whitespace, a minimal top navigation bar with only four items. The screen feels calm and focused. Realistic product screenshot style, same desk angle.
